about.introduction: I am developing practical skills in Python, web development, and introductory AI applications through coursework and guided projects.
story: Java and Python coursework introduced me to debugging and modular design.
AI projects taught me to ask where an answer came from, how invalid inputs are handled, and whether someone else can reproduce the result.
about.careerGoal: I am looking for a junior development role where I can contribute code, API integrations, tests, and documentation while learning through code review.

projectsIntro: Five personal projects with live demos: network visualization, multidimensional chess, SQL analysis, origami, and molecular exploration.
sampleNotice: Project images are screenshots of the live demos. Internet Pulse is shown in simulation mode, and SQL/REPL uses sample data.

projects.name: Internet Pulse
projects.description: Explore internet latency and reachability measurements across an interactive globe and world map.

image.alt: Internet Pulse globe displaying simulated network measurements and latency statistics

roleAndChallenge.label: Feature
roleAndChallenge.text: Switch between a globe and world map to explore internet measurements.

roleAndChallenge.label: Feature
roleAndChallenge.text: Filter observations by probe region and latency, and inspect measurement details.

reflection.label: Design consideration
reflection.text: Connection arcs show measurement endpoints rather than physical cable routes.

reflection.label: Design consideration
reflection.text: Live coverage depends on available probes; simulation offers another way to explore the visualization.

projects.name: 5D Chess · AI Spectator
projects.description: Explore chess across branching timelines, navigate alternate game continuations, and configure AI players.

image.alt: 5D Chess in its dark theme showing the two initial boards

roleAndChallenge.label: Feature
roleAndChallenge.text: Navigate boards and game continuations with move history, undo, and redo.

roleAndChallenge.label: Feature
roleAndChallenge.text: Configure separate AI players, inspect suggested moves, and import or export games.

reflection.label: Design consideration
reflection.text: Branching timelines turn game navigation and visualization into part of the strategy.

reflection.label: Design consideration
reflection.text: AI match controls expose request limits and reported usage alongside player configuration.

projects.name: SQL/REPL
projects.description: Query CSV, Parquet, and JSON with DuckDB in the browser, explore results, and build charts without a backend.

image.alt: SQL/REPL dark editor with highlighted analytics SQL and twelve query result rows

roleAndChallenge.label: Feature
roleAndChallenge.text: Write, run, format, and save SQL queries in a browser workspace.

roleAndChallenge.label: Feature
roleAndChallenge.text: Work with local data files and download query results.

reflection.label: Design consideration
reflection.text: Local-first analysis brings data exploration into the browser without a server or signup.

reflection.label: Design consideration
reflection.text: Queries, tabular results, and charts connect data preparation with interpretation.

projects.name: Origami Lab
projects.description: Explore 25 paper studies in 3D, adjust their folds, and inspect how a flat sheet becomes a structure.

image.alt: Origami Lab displaying a blue Miura tessellation at 65% fold with the pattern collection and paper controls

roleAndChallenge.label: Feature
roleAndChallenge.text: Choose a paper study, drag to fold, and orbit or zoom the 3D model.

roleAndChallenge.label: Feature
roleAndChallenge.text: Inspect crease patterns, change paper colors and studio themes, and import or export geometry.

reflection.label: Design consideration
reflection.text: Linked creases let a sheet change shape as a coordinated structure.

reflection.label: Design consideration
reflection.text: The simulation explores folding behavior; it is not a step-by-step tutorial or a fabrication guarantee.

projects.name: Molecular Explorer
projects.description: Explore biological molecules in an interactive 3D viewer, from hemoglobin and DNA to proteins and RNA.

image.alt: Molecular Explorer showing a three-dimensional molecular structure alongside its molecule selection menu

roleAndChallenge.label: Feature
roleAndChallenge.text: Select among nine molecular examples, then rotate and zoom to inspect their structures.

roleAndChallenge.label: Feature
roleAndChallenge.text: Import molecular files and capture images from the viewer.

reflection.label: Design consideration
reflection.text: Three-dimensional views make molecular shape and organization easier to explore.

reflection.label: Design consideration
reflection.text: A focused viewer keeps the structure prominent while leaving molecule selection and import controls close at hand.
